WITH c AS (
  SELECT customer_id, full_name, kyc_status
  FROM customers
  WHERE customer_id = $1
    AND lower(security_answer) = lower(trim($2))
)
SELECT
  c.customer_id,
  c.full_name,
  c.kyc_status,
  (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(json_build_object(
      'type', a.account_type, 'last4', a.last4, 'balance', a.balance,
      'status', a.status, 'status_reason', a.status_reason,
      'overdraft_limit', a.overdraft_limit, 'interest_rate', a.interest_rate)
      ORDER BY a.account_type), '[]'::json)
   FROM accounts a WHERE a.customer_id = c.customer_id) AS accounts,
  (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(json_build_object(
      'type', k.card_type, 'last4', k.last4, 'status', k.status, 'expiry', k.expiry,
      'daily_limit', k.daily_limit, 'credit_limit', k.credit_limit,
      'outstanding', k.outstanding, 'minimum_payment', k.minimum_payment,
      'payment_due', k.payment_due)
      ORDER BY k.card_type DESC), '[]'::json)
   FROM cards k WHERE k.customer_id = c.customer_id) AS cards,
  (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(json_build_object(
      'type', l.loan_type, 'monthly_payment', l.monthly_payment,
      'remaining_balance', l.remaining_balance, 'next_due_date', l.next_due_date,
      'status', l.status, 'days_past_due', l.days_past_due,
      'interest_rate', l.interest_rate)), '[]'::json)
   FROM loans l WHERE l.customer_id = c.customer_id) AS loans,
  (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(json_build_object(
      'type', t.transfer_type, 'beneficiary', t.beneficiary_name,
      'bank', t.beneficiary_bank, 'amount', t.amount, 'fee', t.fee,
      'initiated', t.initiated_at::date, 'expected', t.expected_completion,
      'status', t.status, 'failure_reason', t.failure_reason)
      ORDER BY t.initiated_at DESC), '[]'::json)
   FROM transfers t
   JOIN accounts a2 ON a2.account_id = t.from_account_id
   WHERE a2.customer_id = c.customer_id
     AND t.initiated_at > now() - interval '60 days') AS transfers,
  (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(json_build_object(
      'ticket_id', tk.ticket_id, 'category', tk.category,
      'description', tk.description, 'status', tk.status,
      'created', tk.created_at::date)
      ORDER BY tk.created_at DESC), '[]'::json)
   FROM tickets tk
   WHERE tk.customer_id = c.customer_id AND tk.status <> 'resolved') AS open_tickets
FROM c;
